sn14.3:1.2: Dhātunānattaṃ bhikkhave paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ || no phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhātunānattaṃ || || 3
sn14.3:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ || no phassanānattam paṭicca uppajjati dhātunattam || || 6
sn14.3:2.2: Cakkhudhātum bhikkhave paṭicca uppajjati cakkhusamphasso || no cakkhusamphassam paṭicca uppajjati cakkhudhātu || pe|| ||
sn14.3:2.3: Manodhātum paṭicca uppajjati manosamphasso || no manosamphassam paṭicca uppajjati manodhātu || || 7
sn14.3:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave dhātunānattam paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattam || no phassanānattam paṭicca uppajjati dhātunānattanti || ||
